pins.name: BUTTON_BUILTIN
pins.label: GPIO0 (Button)
pins.notes: Must be HIGH or floating for normal boot; LOW at boot enters flash/programming mode. No interrupt support. This board's USER/PROG button (pulled up via 10k, pulled to GND when pressed)

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.label: GPIO1
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 TX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: LED_BUILTIN_R
pins.label: GPIO2 (Led Red active low)
pins.notes: Must be HIGH at boot. This board's RGB LED Red channel — active-low (common-anode RGB LED)

pins.name: GPIO3
pins.label: GPIO3
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 RX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: LED_BUILTIN_G
pins.label: GPIO4 (Led Green active low)
pins.notes: This board's RGB LED Green channel — active-low (common-anode RGB LED)

pins.name: LED_BUILTIN_B
pins.label: GPIO5 (Led Blue active low)
pins.notes: This board's RGB LED Blue channel — active-low (common-anode RGB LED)

pins.name: SS
pins.label: SS (GPIO15)
pins.notes: Must be LOW at boot (tied to GND via resistor on most boards)

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes: RTC-domain pin: no internal pull-up/down, no PWM, no interrupt support. Commonly wired to RST for deep-sleep wake

pins.name: A0
pins.label: A0 (GPIO17)
pins.notes: Analog input only (A0) — cannot be used for digital I/O or PWM. Board has an onboard 220k/100k resistor divider extending the native 0-1.0V range to 0-3.2V — see adc.defaultRefVolts
